expires_today.title: 50 Essential Fantagraphics Titles by Fantagraphics
expires_today.long_description: A classic alien invasion thriller! An iconic Sunday strip adventure! A murder investigation with a pulpy twist! When it comes to publishing great comics, Fantagraphics knows what’s up, and if you’ve been looking to get into what this fantastic publisher has to offer, we’ve collected 50 of Fantagraphics’ best titles in one bundle! Solve the murder of a mysterious woman alongside a horror-obsessed 10-year-old in My Favorite Thing Is Monsters! Escape to an era of medieval swordfights and epic adventures with the first two collected volumes of Prince Valiant! Fight back against a devastating alien invasion in the subversive Argentine masterwork The Eternaut! All of these and many more are featured in this bundle of 50—yes, F-I-F-T-Y—of Fantagraphics’ best titles, so grab them now at the price of your choosing, and support the Freedom of the Press Foundation with your purchase!

expires_today.title: SkullForge Studios Arsenal Mega Bundle
expires_today.long_description: Pay what you want for the ultimate collection of Arsenal printable minis for any occasion or the hit tabletop skirmish game by SkullForge Studios! This action-packed game pits fireteams of badass mercenaries against each other for contract payouts and glory. Each fireteam plays 5 drop troopers and 1 mega mech known as MCVs. Our Mega Bundle assembles hundreds of unique playables from terrain to vanguards like Arsenal Terrain: Mech Bay and Crew and Arsenal Fireteam: Zeta. Dominate the combat zone alongside your friends and help support the World Wildlife Fund with your purchase!

expires_today.title: Voice Vault: The ultimate collection of human-made voice lines
expires_today.description: Unlock premium spoken lines with Voice Vault
expires_today.long_description:
Get everything you need to create authentic, engaging characters who resonate with your players with Voice Vault: The Ultimate Collection of Human‑made Voice Lines. Choose from 100+ human voice recordings with over 600 professionally recorded lines from professional voices like Bryce Garland, D’laina Hunt, Hannah Weeks, Ntlanhla Kutu, and more. Pay what you want for subscription‑ and royalty‑free audio packs from the industry’s biggest and boldest voices, and help support Children’s Miracle Network with your purchase!

Codes are redeemable through the Ovani website.

expires_today.description: Cozy up to great games this fall

expires_today.title: The Best of C.J. Cherryh by Daw Books
expires_today.long_description: Traverse planets, galaxies, and whole universes of adventure and mystery in this bundle of award-winning author C.J. Cherryh’s best novels! Start with her Hugo Award-winning sci-fi novel Downbelow Station, set on a backwater planet and its space station caught in the middle of an intergalactic war! Dive into the author’s classic (and extensive) space opera series full of assassination, mystery, and interspecies intrigue with Foreigner 10th Anniversary Edition! Take her high fantasy classics for a spin with all four books of The Complete Morgaine, following a woman tasked with saving the very fabric of reality from an ancient network of portals! There’s so much more to explore in this bundle of 30+ sci-fi and fantasy ebooks from one of the greatest working authors of our time, so grab them now at the price of your choice and support BINC with your purchase!

expires_today.title: Meshingun All-Stars
expires_today.long_description:
Discover the Meshingun All-Stars Bundle, bringing together some of Meshingun’s biggest hits and best-selling Mega Packs in one massive collection. Get thousands of high-quality, production-ready assets covering horror, apocalyptic, abandoned, historical, Feudal Japan, World War themes, and more. Whether you’re building your next game, cinematic, or environment, this bundle gives you a huge range of assets to create more while saving serious production time. Professional License included.

Keys expire. Please redeem your keys before September 24th, 2027.

expires_today.title: CRPG Pack: Isometric Immersion
expires_today.long_description:
Isometric games—that is, games that use a little projection trick to make the map look 3-D—give players a whole new way to move their characters around a world. Because we love celebrating unique perspectives, we’ve collected our favorite isometric games in one convenient bundle! Gather your crew, board your voidship, and travel through uncharted regions of space in Warhammer 40,000: Rogue Trader! Take on a world infested with demons and develop powers of mythic proportions in the Game of the Year Edition of Pathfinder: Wrath of the Righteous! Try to solve a murder while also trying to uncover your own past in the groundbreaking detective RPG Disco Elysium - The Final Cut! More fantastic adventures and unforgettable stories await you in this bundle of isometric classics, so grab them now at the price of your choice, and support Little Free Library with your purchase!

Keys expire. Please redeem before March 23rd, 2027

expires_within_72h.title: Garbage Dwellers
expires_within_72h.description: One man's trash is another man’s treasure.
expires_within_72h.long_description:
One man's trash is another man’s treasure. Good things happen in the bin—pay what you want for the Trash Dwellers Bundle of filthy fun games! Play A Plague Tale: Innocence and follow the grim tale of Amicia and her younger brother in a heart‑wrenching story of their darkest hours. Run ’n’ gun against the TechnoRat army alongside your tailed troops in the legendary Great Rat War of WAR RATS: The Rat em Up, or dive into a wholesome, cozy, trashy game with no shortage of rubbish in Trash Goblin. Save big on disgustingly good games and help support Canine Companions with your purchase!

The RAT PACK includes one (1) game key, selected at random from the four titles below by an automated randomization tool. You cannot choose which title you receive, and the title is revealed only after purchase:

  • Seize the Cheese
  • Dimensional Animals
  • The Lost Legends of Redwall: The Scout Anthology
  • Tanuki Sunset

Your Chances: Keys are stocked in near-equal quantities across the four titles; no title makes up more than approximately 27% of the total pool, and no title accounts for less than approximately 21%. Keys are drawn randomly from remaining stock, so the mix shifts as titles sell out. 
One (1) key per bundle purchased. Because there are only four titles, buying multiple bundles may result in a duplicate key purchase. A duplicate key cannot be redeemed a second time on the same Steam account, and Humble Support cannot exchange a key for a different title. Duplicate keys are not transferable.
All keys are Steam keys and require a Steam account.

Keys expire. Please redeem and activate on Steam before April 9th, 2027.
